prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, late 20s goddess, super glamour physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size; below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long straight auburn hair — wearing a glossy cherry-red PVC micro halter bikini top of two small opaque triangle cups joined by a small metal ring at the center, thin glossy cherry-red PVC halter strings tied behind her neck, and a minimal low-rise glossy cherry-red PVC bottom of one tiny opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque pieces fully covering her, her stomach bare. Her waist wears a silver chain waist harness of a fine chain around her waist and another around her hips, joined by several fine chains draped in a diagonal lattice over her stomach, a small silver chain tassel resting at her navel. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame — most extreme super glamour silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy cherry-red PVC, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in glossy cherry-red lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and large drop earrings, a gold chain ending in a heavy black iron bell on one ear and a silver chain ending in a heavy gold pendant on the other, hanging above her collarbones. Jewelry is metal and pearl only.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme, thick opaque layers piled on: an opaque thick white eyeshadow smeared from the lash line up to the brows, thick white paint under the lower lashes, a very wide bright turquoise liner flaring far past the outer corners, extremely long clumped false lashes top and bottom, opaque glossy white lips.

Background: a bright minimalist loft studio with pale concrete floors, tall factory windows, a standard door and a row of standard-height steps, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
